# Guideline Central

> > The world's largest clinical guideline library, aggregating evidence-based medical standards and practice parameters from leading healthcare organizations.

Guideline Central is a comprehensive repository of clinical guidelines and summaries from major medical associations and specialty societies. The platform serves healthcare professionals by centralizing access to authoritative clinical decision-support resources across multiple medical specialties including cardiology, neurology, psychiatry, oncology, and allergy/immunology.

## Key Topics

- Clinical Guidelines
- Evidence-Based Practice
- Medical Standards
- Clinical Decision Support
- Guideline Summaries
- Allergy and Asthma
- Cardiology
- Neurology
- Oncology
- Psychiatry
- Healthcare Resources
- Medical Practice Parameters
- Patient Summaries
- Anaphylaxis
- Food Allergy

## Core Platform

- [Guideline Central - The Largest Guideline Library in the World!](https://www.guidelinecentral.com): Homepage for Guideline Central, the world's largest clinical guideline library platform

## Allergy, Asthma & Immunology Guidelines

- [American Academy of Allergy, Asthma & Immunology Guidelines & Clinical Guidelines Summaries](https://www.guidelinecentral.com/guidelines/aaaai): AAAAI clinical guidelines and summaries for allergy, asthma, and immunology
- [American College of Allergy, Asthma, and Immunology Guidelines & Clinical Guidelines Summaries](https://www.guidelinecentral.com/guidelines/acaai): ACAAI clinical guidelines and medical references for allergy and immunology

## Cardiovascular & Stroke Guidelines

- [American College of Cardiology Guidelines & Clinical Guidelines Summaries](https://www.guidelinecentral.com/guidelines/acc): ACC cardiology guidelines for cardiovascular health and clinical decision support
- [American Heart Association Guidelines & Clinical Guidelines Summaries](https://www.guidelinecentral.com/guidelines/aha): AHA cardiovascular disease guidelines for stroke and cardiac condition management
- [American Stroke Association Guidelines & Clinical Guidelines Summaries](https://www.guidelinecentral.com/guidelines/asa-stroke): ASA stroke guidelines for acute stroke management and stroke prevention

## Neurology, Mental Health & Addiction Guidelines

- [American Academy of Neurology Guidelines & Clinical Guidelines Summaries](https://www.guidelinecentral.com/guidelines/aan): AAN clinical guidelines and summaries for neurology and brain health conditions
- [American Psychiatric Association Guidelines & Clinical Guidelines Summaries](https://www.guidelinecentral.com/guidelines/apa): APA psychiatry guidelines for mental health treatment and disorder management
- [American Society of Addiction Medicine Guidelines & Clinical Guidelines Summaries](https://www.guidelinecentral.com/guidelines/asam): ASAM addiction medicine guidelines for opioid and substance use disorder treatment

## Surgical, Perioperative & Specialty Care Guidelines

- [American Society of Anesthesiologists Guidelines & Clinical Guidelines Summaries](https://www.guidelinecentral.com/guidelines/asa): ASA anesthesiology guidelines for perioperative care and surgical practice
- [American Academy of Otolaryngology - Head and Neck Surgery Foundation Guidelines & Clinical Guidelines Summaries](https://www.guidelinecentral.com/guidelines/aao-hns): AAO-HNS guidelines for otolaryngology and head and neck surgery standards
- [American Limb Preservation Society Guidelines & Clinical Guidelines Summaries](https://www.guidelinecentral.com/guidelines/alps): ALPS guidelines for limb preservation and diabetic foot ulcer nutrition interventions

## Primary Care, Pediatrics & Rehabilitation Guidelines

- [American Academy of Family Physicians Guidelines & Clinical Guidelines Summaries](https://www.guidelinecentral.com/guidelines/aafp): AAFP clinical guidelines for family medicine, immunization, and cardiovascular care
- [American Academy of Pediatric Dentistry Guidelines & Clinical Guidelines Summaries](https://www.guidelinecentral.com/guidelines/aapd): AAPD clinical guidelines for pediatric dentistry and children's oral health
- [American Physical Therapy Association Guidelines & Clinical Guidelines Summaries](https://www.guidelinecentral.com/guidelines/apta): APTA physical therapy guidelines and practice standards for PT management

## Gastroenterology, Rheumatology, Oncology & Lifestyle Medicine Guidelines

- [American Gastroenterological Association Guidelines & Clinical Guidelines Summaries](https://www.guidelinecentral.com/guidelines/aga): AGA gastroenterology guidelines for GI disease management and evidence-based practice
- [American College of Rheumatology Guidelines & Clinical Guidelines Summaries](https://www.guidelinecentral.com/guidelines/acr): ACR clinical guidelines and medical standards for rheumatology disease management
- [American Society of Clinical Oncology Guidelines & Clinical Guidelines Summaries](https://www.guidelinecentral.com/guidelines/asco): ASCO oncology guidelines for cancer treatment and evidence-based clinical practice
- [American College of Lifestyle Medicine Guidelines & Clinical Guidelines Summaries](https://www.guidelinecentral.com/guidelines/aclm): ACLM guidelines for lifestyle medicine, obesity treatment, and diabetes management
- [Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics Guidelines & Clinical Guidelines Summaries](https://www.guidelinecentral.com/guidelines/and): AND nutrition and dietetics guidelines for evidence-based nutrition therapy
